propositions: docs/reuse-surface.md requires recurring manual upkeep (~20+ commits) to stay synchronized with signature changes
test_reuse_surface_doc.py hardcodes a curated subset of signatures and must be hand-edited in lockstep with every signature change, creating a manual maintenance burden

a portable surface drift gate (modeled on griffe check) using pure-stdlib introspection (inspect/importlib) runs under make test with no CI-provider dependency and fails on added/removed/renamed public symbols or changed signatures

the committed baseline (api_surface_baseline.json) captures public members from pinned modules (rebar facade plus documented reuse subsystems) via __all__ or owned non-underscore attributes, with callable parameters, class bases, dataclass fields, and immutable constant values pinned
scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check detects drift vs baseline in subprocess (immune to unit-test monkeypatches) and --update accepts intentional changes
the deleted test_reuse_surface_doc.py hardcoded assertions are subsumed by the automatic surface gate with no loss of coverage over signing/prompt-library/runner-contract/workflow-executor symbols
